legal_consequences.refill: Schedule II prescriptions may not be refilled.
legal_consequences.transfer: A patient-requested partial-fill remainder is not a transferable refill.
legal_consequences.partial_fill: Massachusetts patient-requested Schedule II partial-fill timing and same-pharmacy conditions may apply.
legal_consequences.masspat: Covered Schedule II dispensing transactions are MassPAT-reportable.
legal_consequences.quantity_limit: As a non-opioid Schedule II drug, it may qualify for the Massachusetts 90-day single-fill pathway when all conditions are met.
